rateTitle: Share price growth from {from} to {to}, net of the vault's fees

card.title: Earn on idle {symbol}
card.runBy: Run by {curator} on {protocol}. Can lose money. No openlaunch fee.

dialog.title: Earn on {symbol}
dialog.description: Lend your {symbol} through a {protocol} vault on Base. Take it out whenever the vault has it free.

unconfirmed.title: Sent, not confirmed yet
unconfirmed.deposit: Your wallet sent the deposit of {amount} {symbol}, but its confirmation could not be read. It may still go through. Do not send it again until this is settled.
unconfirmed.withdraw: Your wallet sent the withdrawal of {amount} {symbol}, but its confirmation could not be read. It may still go through. Do not send it again until this is settled.
unconfirmed.batch: It was sent as one batch from your wallet; your wallet’s activity shows whether it went through.
unconfirmed.keep: Closing this sheet keeps the check. Reloading the page forgets it, so look at your wallet’s activity before sending again.

done.depositedBody: Your {symbol} is in {vault} on {chain}. Its value updates as the vault earns.
done.withdrewBody: The {symbol} is back in your wallet on {chain}.

notice.approval: The first deposit asks your wallet twice: once to allow the vault exactly this amount, then to deposit it. Smart wallets do both in one step.
notice.everything: Withdraws your whole deposit, with the interest earned up to the moment it confirms.
notice.noGas: This wallet has no ETH on {chain} to pay network gas.
notice.unreadable: Your balances could not be read just now. They refresh on their own.

disclaimer: Deposits can lose money. Your {symbol} is lent to borrowers through {protocol}, in markets chosen by {curator}, not by openlaunch. openlaunch never holds your funds, cannot move them and cannot guarantee a withdrawal: the vault pays out from what is not lent at that moment. The rate changes all the time; past rates promise nothing.

reasons.moreThanHeld: That is more USDC than this wallet holds.
reasons.approvalUnreadable: The approval's confirmation could not be read. Nothing was deposited; try again (an approval that went through is reused).
reasons.approvalReverted: The approval reverted on-chain. Nothing was deposited.
reasons.nothingInWallet: Nothing is deposited from this wallet.
reasons.accountChanged: Your wallet switched accounts, so this stopped before anything else was sent. Start again from the account you want to use.
reasons.flowStopped: Stopped: the Earn card closed before the next step.
reasons.notConfirmedYet: Still no confirmation. It can take a while when the network is busy; check again in a moment, or look at your wallet's activity.
reasons.batchFailed: Your wallet reports the transaction failed. Nothing moved; check its activity before trying again.
reasons.depositReverted: The deposit reverted on-chain. Nothing moved; network gas was still charged.
reasons.withdrawalReverted: The withdrawal reverted on-chain. Nothing moved; network gas was still charged.
reasons.gates: The vault now restricts who may use it.
reasons.performanceFee: The vault now keeps {fee} of the interest it earns.
reasons.managementFee: The vault now charges a {fee} yearly management fee.
reasons.paused: Deposits are paused here: {reason} openlaunch listed this vault without that and has not reviewed the change. Withdrawals stay open.
